snippet.title: The Left Behind - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
In this demo you can play the first 30 minutes of the game: The Left Behind. The demo features a handcrafted post-apocalyptic world. Explore a typical Dutch open-world landscape at daytime and beware of hordes of enemies coming in at night. Loot and hunt to survive. Each night, the game becomes increasingly challenging. Keep track of your highscore and try to survive as many nights as possible and/or play through an immersive and mysterious story!

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2433630/The_Left_Behind/

Official Discord: https://discord.gg/ZUUwNHzDxX
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theleftbehindgame/
X: https://twitter.com/Game_LeftBehind
Website: https://www.trudex.nl/

Music for this video is an original track for the game made by Between the Rains: https://play.reelcrafter.com/VXQpGlPZSWS5DdaYmJn5rw
Copyright Trudex. Not licensed for reproduction or use in any format without written approval.

The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game developed by solo developer Justin Jager.
